title: The Importance of Regular Health Check-Ups
excerpt: Many serious conditions can be detected early with regular screening. Learn which check-ups are recommended for your age group and when to schedule them.
body: Preventive healthcare is one of the most powerful tools we have. Regular health assessments allow your GP to detect potential issues early — when they're most treatable. Recommended screenings vary by age: In your 20s and 30s, focus on blood pressure, cholesterol, mental health, and skin checks. In your 40s and 50s, add bowel cancer screening, mammograms, and diabetes risk assessment. From 65+, bone density, vision, and hearing checks become important. Book a health assessment today — it could make all the difference.
